text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE original adult character for a coordinated 28-character premium romantic 3D CG collection. Style: high-end Chinese otome game / animated cinematic character modeling, subtly idealized sculpted facial anatomy, luminous smooth translucent skin with fine restrained microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, beautiful detailed eyes, individually groomed wispy hair strands, finely rendered fabric/metal. Clearly polished dimensional CG rather than a real-person photograph. NOT gritty, no coarse pores, no plastic doll sheen, no outlines. Scene: solid PURE WHITE #FFFFFF seamless background. Lighting: bright soft neutral frontal studio light with balanced fill, delicate facial modeling shadows, subtle luminous bloom, no dramatic darkness or colored backdrop. Composition: EXACT 1024x1536 portrait 2:3. A single centered frontal eye-level character, head upright shoulders level, looking at viewer; waist-up to lower chest portrait. Entire hair, head ornaments and shoulders visible with 8% blank white margin above topmost hair or ears. Same camera distance, head including hair around 40% of canvas height. 85mm-like perspective. Relaxed arms down, hands outside frame. Design a clearly new identity, not a replica of any known game character or reference portrait: specific distinct eye shape, nose, lips, jaw and proportions described below are crucial. All adults. No text, brands, watermarks, signature, frames, labels, collage or additional people.
Character design: Adult MALE fox spirit age 28, regal athletic humanoid. Long dark plum hair tied high, two sweeping deep-purple fox ears with gold-tipped fur, fully inside frame. Burnished ruby eyes, wide strong cheekbones, long nose with softly broad tip, sharp brows, full well-shaped lips, square tapered jaw. Warm porcelain skin. Original fine gold forehead ornament with a single oval garnet, new sparse abstract crimson markings at temples and shoulders. Sculpted antique-gold upper chest armor with burgundy silk drape and layered fine gold collar; tasteful non-explicit fantasy costume. Proud composed frontal gaze. Ears and ponytail wholly visible.
Final composition requirement: uniform pure white background; complete hairstyle and ornaments or animal ears fully visible; at least 90 pixels of clear white space above the tallest point, centered frontal eye-level portrait, shoulders and upper torso visible. Bright neutral soft frontal studio lighting.
reproduction_note: 已保留本次确认原图与实际生成记录；文字提示词未经复现验证，严格保持身份请使用本张身份母版。 本张经过白底或留白修订，独立提示词由原始角色描述与最终构图要求重建。

original_prompt: Edit the provided original 3D character portrait ONLY to fix the framing. Preserve EXACT same face, identity, expression, hairstyle, hair color, entire costume and ornament design, skin material, pure white background, soft bright frontal illumination and premium 3D CG look. Pull the camera back about 15 percent and extend the missing top detail naturally so that ALL of the topmost hair, headpiece, crown, ponytail and any animal ear tips are COMPLETELY visible, with at least 100 pixels EMPTY PURE WHITE margin above the highest point. The topmost feature must NOT touch the image edge. Centered straight-on eye-level portrait from full head ornament through upper torso, relaxed arms down, no new objects. Final image exactly 1024x1536, solid white #FFFFFF background, no frame or text.
